name: forge
description: Claude Code plugins for making things: design-forge for visual work, story-forge for long-form fiction, deck-forge for presentations. All built on the same idea — judgment stays with the model, and anything expressed as a number gets measured instead of eyeballed.

plugins.name: design-forge
plugins.description: Adversarial builder/critic loop, a measurement harness that computes what a screenshot cannot show (type ladder, worst-case accent count, WCAG contrast, target size), a licence-cleared asset library, a scroll-film site builder, and a three-pass prose de-slopper.

plugins.name: story-forge
plugins.description: A long-form fiction pipeline: braindump to dossier, outlining, story-hacking, drafting, a three-pass line edit that strips AI prose patterns, a continuity and chronology audit, and a final export that removes invisible provenance characters.

plugins.name: deck-forge
plugins.description: Build decks from shape primitives so they survive a Google Slides import fully editable, then measure them: type legibility derived from angular subtense, WCAG contrast resolved against the real backdrop by z-order, and native-chart detection. The builder cannot express a native chart, so compliance is structural rather than advisory.
